arms.R: NEW: PSI40 entry/budget/necessity + PSI41 evidence-driven structural identification (version space of constructed structures, unknown cells, discriminating experiments, synthesis only when identified, re-identification on refutation)
arms.RDq: V2 control: R's SOURCE queries replayed and solved passively (Dq), no formation
arms.Rno: NEW-no-state: R with the identified state withheld (same identification and experiments)

criteria.CORE_EVIDENCE (per task): R robustly verifies it with an accepted machine containing an identified state, and none of A, Q, Rno robustly verifies it
criteria.REGRESSION: tasks A robustly verifies and R does not (reported, never excluded)
criteria.V2 rule (frozen V2 criterion, R in D's p: >= 5 tasks solved by R (hidden test) with an accepted machine of m >= 2 state components that RDq does not solve; the same count with verified solves is reported as the substantive check
criteria.V2 verdict: PASS if the V2 rule is met AND >= 5 of its tasks carry core evidence; FAIL if the rule is not met; OPEN otherwise
criteria.cost: real CPU and formation SOURCE queries per arm and group, reported separately from accuracy
criteria.hidden_test_only: solves that pass the hidden test but fail the random diagnostic inputs are reported per arm and never counted as invention evidence
criteria.official: sealed V1 PASS, V2 FAIL (FORMAL) / independent OPEN, V3 FAIL, Q3 OPEN unchanged; V3 not evaluated
criteria.robust: strict majority of the arm's runs on the task (the base run alone if not replicated)
criteria.verified_solve: hidden test passed AND every random diagnostic SOURCE input correct (300 inputs, seed 777)

evaluation_set.disclosure: fst and rha are the developer-authored families used in development (new draws, every earlier task excluded, including the 16 Phase 3 tasks); lr_* are new compositions of the independent list-routines lineage

harness: research/q3/budgeted_reach_dev.py (run_arm('D'); Env(spec, 0, budget=60); seed sha256(name) % 1000; fresh process per (arm, task, seed); --semantic; --workers 4; PYTHONHASHSEED=0)
no_post_hoc: PSI41 code, arms, task lists, seeds and criteria are not changed after this commit
not_counted: every section 35-40 task and the 16 Phase 3 tasks (development data)

runs.RDq: every task R solves (hidden test) in its base run, replaying that run
runs.replication: every task whose verified outcome differs between any two arms run on it: 2 more same-seed runs and seeds 1, 2 (sha256(name) + 7919 k), for every arm run on that task

status: FROZEN before any agent run on the evaluation set (development only; official sealed verdicts unchanged)
